ios.desc:
Dine fearlessly in 150+ languages.

Tired of confusing menus and awkward food ordering while traveling? YUPE is your AI-powered food assistant that helps you understand any menu, discover the right dishes, and order with confidence—no translations or guesswork required.

Whether you’re abroad or at a local restaurant with unfamiliar cuisine, YUPE ensures you get exactly what you want, tailored to your taste and dietary needs.

Key Features:

- Instant Menu Translation:
Translate any menu into your language with one tap. Get full clarity on ingredients and descriptions before you order.

- Personalized Dish Recommendations:
Tell YUPE what you feel like eating—whether it’s something spicy, vegetarian, or sweet—and get the best options from the menu.

- Tailored to Your Preferences:
YUPE remembers your allergies, dietary restrictions, and preferences, delivering safe and personalized suggestions every time.

- Built for Travelers and Food Lovers:
Order with confidence in any country or culture. YUPE bridges the language gap so you can enjoy food experiences without limits.

Discover, understand, and enjoy new foods—without hesitation.

Download YUPE and experience dining with total confidence.

quotes.text:
Hi HN,

I just launched YUPE, an iOS app that helps travelers understand and order from restaurant menus—even when they can’t read the local language.

Why I built it

  Food is one of the best ways to experience a culture, but language barriers often make it hard to know what you’re ordering.

  I wanted a way to explore any country’s gastronomy confidently—even if I couldn’t read the menu or speak the language.


What it does

  - Scan a menu

  - Chat with it — Ask questions like “Is this spicy?” or “Which dishes are dairy-free?”

  - Get personalized suggestions — Based on your preferences and allergies

  - One-tap order — Generates a polite, localized message you can show to the waiter


Currently supports 150+ languages. Designed for travelers, digital nomads, and curious foodies.

Privacy

  - No sign-up required for core features

  - Your food preferences are stored anonymously to personalize responses


Links

  - Website: https://yupe.app 

  - App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/yupe-dine-anywhere/id6743195643 


Would love feedback from the HN community!
